test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following questions a statement has been given with highlighted text. Select the options that can replace the text with correct idiom or phrase.

Reginald **betrayed** his closest friend. It was big shock for all.

options.text: Every cloud has a silver lining

solution:
The correct answer is "**stab someone in the back**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Betrayed** means to **cheat someone**.

 
 
• **Example:** *The agent **betrayed** me by giving me a different house from the picture.*
 
 
 
• **Stab someone in the back **means **deceive** someone.
 
 
• **Example:** *The shopkeeper **stabbed the customer on his back** by selling a defective piece. *
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate idiom which means "betrayed" is "stab someone in the back". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see the other idioms given in the options.

 to put an extra effort to succeed.
 *If Tom needs to lead the score board, he needs to **look at his laurels**.*
 
 

 **A black sheep**
 The odd one of the group.
 *Martha was **the black sheep** in the gang as she was the only girl.*
 
 

 **Every cloud has a silver lining**
 even a bad situation has some hope.
 *Nora was able to score well despite her accident. She believed that **every cloud has a silver lining. ***
